newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Johnson's Well in deal with Creasy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Johnson's Well in deal with Creasy.

text.p: Joseph Gutnick's Johnson's Well Mining NL said on Monday it has reached a joint venture agreement with Australian mining identity Mark Creasy over an exploration license in the Duken belt near Laveton in Western Australia.
Johnson's Well said it could earn a 61 per cent interest in the tenement 100 km north-north-west of Laverton by paying Creasy a total of A$100,000.

The tenement is located 15 to 20 km north-west of Johnson's Wells' King John prospect, where drilling has identified a number of zones containing gold, copper and silver mineralisation, the company said.
Johnson said it will pay Creasy A$50,000 within seven days and a further A$50,000 within six months, and will be responsible for exploration costs
Creasy will contribute A$25,000 toward prospecting and development expense within 120 days of signing and a further A$25,000 toward prospecting and development within 480 days, Johnson's Well said.
Gutnick is chairman of Johnson's Well.
Creasy, a long-time prospector, has become a multi-millionaire by finding and selling major gold deposits in Western Australia.
